findings.text: approve_in_app failed: 400 {'detail': 'report_project_id=e37f187f-dcb7-4b76-a3df-2d7cf9fe36a2にはまだCollection Runがありません（Report Studio側でRunを実行してからReviewを依頼してください）'}. Root cause: pilot driver omitted an explicit version_snapshot; the endpoint's auto-snapshot fallback requires a real Report Studio Collection Run, which this pilot deliberately never invoked. Fixed in the driver script (pilot_run.py / pilot_continue.py), not a product defect.

publish failed: 500 {'raw_text': 'Internal Server Error'}. Root cause: Phase E SQL migration (2026-09-16b_geo_ios_knowledge_publication.sql) had not actually been applied to the live DB despite two earlier user confirmations -- confirmed via direct PostgREST 42703 undefined_column errors on geo_knowledge_items.source_report_project_id and geo_ios_approval_events.publication_status. Resolved after user re-ran the migration a third time. Not a code defect; the code correctly assumed the documented additive schema.

extract_learning failed once: 500 {'raw_text': 'Internal Server Error'} immediately after publish succeeded (which itself immediately followed the migration/schema-cache-reload fix). Retried within ~1 minute via direct function call (no error) and then via the live HTTP endpoint (200 OK, idempotent_reuse=true, identical candidate). Likely a brief PostgREST schema-cache propagation window right after the NOTIFY pgrst reload; not reproducible, no code change made. Flagged for awareness (a real production pilot might want a retry-on-5xx for publish-adjacent calls), not for immediate action.
